svg.aria-label: Timeline of two frames without overlap. The CPU records and then waits while the GPU, idle during recording, executes, so each processor is idle about half the time. The CPU's wait ends when execution does; on a third lane the presentation engine presents each frame after that, while the CPU records the next one.
